record.summary: The render matches the reference apart from the accepted deviations. The Appearance card is 100 px taller because of the disabled Text size control and the new Chat width row, so the Navigation card starts 100 px lower (y 465 to y 565 in the 1:1 crops). Row pitch, widths, text and controls are otherwise the same.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Text size: the control is disabled (muted labels) and its line under it says "Coming soon" in place of "Scales the whole app: Small 87.5 %, Default 100 %, Large 112.5 %." (step D adds text size later). On a narrow screen the one-line note makes every section below it sit about one text line higher.
accepted_deviations.note: Small, Default and Large are muted. Default still has its selected outline. The line under the control says "Coming soon" at the same y as the reference note (about y 398). The narrow-screen effect does not apply at this desktop width.

accepted_deviations.as_given: A new "NOTIFICATIONS" section with one "Notifications" switch (off) sits between the Navigation section and the New chat defaults section. So New chat defaults sits lower, or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: The Navigation card goes below the bottom edge of the render, so the Notifications section is out of view. New chat defaults is below the bottom edge, as the description allows.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Notifications switch moved to that section: the desktop rail no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" switch at its bottom, and the More drawer no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" row at its end. So the drawer is shorter and its top edge sits lower.
accepted_deviations.note: The rail in the render has no switch at its bottom; the reference has one near y 910 to 955. The More drawer is closed in both pictures, so the drawer part cannot be seen.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Navigation list has a new last row, "Settings", with the line "Always shown: in the bar or under More." under it and up and down buttons but no switch (the owner's decision: Settings is an entry of the bar order that cannot be hidden). So Toolkit's down button is now enabled, the Navigation card is taller, and every section below it sits lower or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: Toolkit's down arrow is dark (enabled) in the render and muted in the reference. The card goes past the bottom edge after the Toolkit row, so the new Settings row itself is not in view.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Appearance has a new last row, "Chat width", under Text size: a three-way control "Full", "Wide", "Narrow" with Full selected, and a line under it. On the desktop and the tablet the control is enabled and the line says "The messages and the message box of a Workspaces chat, centred."; on the phone the control is disabled (muted labels) and the line says "Phone: always full". So the Appearance card is taller, and every section below it sits lower (about one row) or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: The Chat width row is enabled, Full is selected, and the line says "The messages and the message box of a Workspaces chat, centred." The card is 100 px taller and the sections below it moved down by the same amount.

limits: The side-by-side image was shown scaled down (3048x1010 to 2576x854), so the review used the 1:1 half crops for detail.
The content below y 982 in the render (the Navigation Settings row, the Notifications section and New chat defaults) is below the bottom edge and could not be checked.
The More drawer is closed in both pictures, so the drawer part of A3 could not be checked.
